title: Kirillov projector on arbitrary mirabolic Whittaker modules
author: Artem Kalmykov
difficulty_reason: A denominator-free ordered infinite projector must simultaneously satisfy opposite-side Whittaker and shifted-Borel annihilation. The author proves these by interlocking rank and root-column inductions using evaluated Yangian minors; this cannot be replaced by the ordinary extremal projector or the short uniqueness argument.
